name: granttap
description: Pair local coding agents with GrantTap and approve, answer, or steer their work from iPhone and Apple Watch.

interface.shortDescription: Connect GrantTap by QR or Mac passkey
interface.longDescription: Try now / Connect GrantTap opens the connection card. Add a device, Add another device, or Reconnect shows a one-time QR for GrantTap on iPhone or iPad; QR pairing needs no account. Authenticate opens granttap.com/connect, where a fresh GrantTap account passkey on Mac can also authorize this local MCP client. Passkey authorization does not pair a phone. Pairing stays out of chat.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this computer is connected to GrantTap.
